answer: Dilini is 21, daughter of Nimal and Kumari, accepted to the Colombo Medical Faculty (this happens in E1S2). She wears a saree, has dark hair, and in episode 2 she leaves the village for medical school. In this scene (E2S2) she’s packing her anatomy textbooks into a cloth bag and speaks the lines shown; she’s anxious about leaving (she says she is afraid).
